groups.title: Hydraulic slip rolls · value line
groups.lead: HER slip rolls with all three rolls driven hydraulically, 12 ga to 1/2″ over 4 to 10 ft — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: For sheet and light plate, NovoTech's value-line HER hydraulic slip rolls, built in China, roll 12 ga to 1/2″ over 4 to 10 ft with all three rolls driven hydraulically.
points_add: NovoTech value line: HER hydraulic slip rolls, 12 ga – 1/2″ × 4 – 10 ft

faq_add.a: A slip roll is a light three-roll machine for sheet — duct, flues, tanks, hoppers, signage — with a top roll that swings out to slip the finished cylinder off. A plate roller rolls heavier plate and pre-bends the edges so the cylinder closes round. The HER hydraulic slip rolls bridge the two: all three rolls driven hydraulically, 12 ga to 1/2″ over 6′7″.

set.hero_brand_line: ISITAN and NovoTech premium line plate rolls are made in Turkey — ISITAN Makine since 1959, the NovoTech premium line built to NovoTech's specification — with European components; NovoTech's value-line slip rolls are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
